{{Quote|We're down to a single major shipyard and it can't keep up with demand for capital ships.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ardiff]]|<ref name="SotP">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref>}}
The '''Yaga Minor shipyards''' were the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] renowned [[Shipyard/Legends|ship building facilities]] of [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]].

==History==
{{Quote|Look at all that new construction. They aren't kidding around, are they?''"<br />"''No, they're not. Nor are they kidding around at Ord Trasi or Yaga Minor.|[[Dankin]] and [[Talon Karrde]], about the [[Bilbringi Shipyards]]|<ref name="TLC" />}}
During the reign of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], the shipyards were fully under his control, under his orders, the shipyards were to begin production of [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="TLC" />

By the signing of the [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty|Bastion Accords]], the Yaga Minor shipyards were the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant's]] last [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]].<ref name="VotF" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the shipyards were [[Infiltration of the Yaga Minor shipyards|infiltrated]] by a group of [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteurs]], as well as the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lady]] [[Lumiya]].<ref name="I, Yuuzhan Vong">{{GamerCite|8|I, Yuuzhan Vong}}</ref> They were later also affiliated with the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].<ref name="Force Heretic I: Remnant" />

They would eventually be under the control of the [[Fel Empire]], and later [[Empire-in-exile]].<ref name="TEA" />
